title: Rationale
html:
Rationale

Portfolio

What I looked at and left out of the ledger, and why.

1. JPMorgan (4.1%): its own news this month is a payments outage, a vendor cyberattack with 'no disruption to our services', and a CFO handover after Q1 2027; none is sized to move the holding by more than the market does, and its rate and credit exposure is carried by the Fed rows. 2. Toyota (2.7%) and the yen: USD/JPY is near 159.5 and Toyota's forecast assumes 157; a stronger yen cuts Toyota's profit but raises the dollar value of the ADR, so the net effect on this holding is small either way. 3. A Ukraine settlement (Trump-Putin-Xi talks on Nov 19): lower oil would cost Exxon and help the international fund, roughly offsetting here. 4. AI regulation from the incoming Democratic Congress: the Nov 5 fall (Nasdaq -5.5%) priced the fear; with a presidential veto, law inside the horizon is unlikely, and the AI-downturn row carries the consequence if the build-out slows. 5. The run of outages at Microsoft, JPMorgan, Apple and the FAA: officials deny a coordinated attack; I found no way to put a probability on a systemic cyber event and no market that asks it. 6. A generic 'bear market' row: an index level is where the events above would show, not an event of its own, so I removed it. 7. Novo's 2027 guidance in February is a second Novo catalyst beside the CagriSema decision; I did not find a consensus figure to define it against.
